x: Up front spectators were treated to one of the finest finishes ever with the result in doubt until Elswick's Mike McLeod burst away from Ford (Aldershot), Rose (Bristol) and Kenyon (Bolton) with only 150 metres to go.
Most of the familiar British runners took part despite the hefty entry fees and an awesome 10k M40 field, the race being won by Mick McLeod.
Steve Cram, Mick McLeod and Belgrave's Gary Staines were together through the mile markers in 4:47, 9:40 and 14:24 before McLeod and then Staines were dropped by the World 1 Mile Record Holder.
